Much-loved 2 bedroom apartment

  4. Sea Point

Much-loved 2 bedroom apartment

ZAR 9,900,000~€530,932
  • 2 Bedrooms
  • 2 Bathrooms
  • ~108 m² Living area

Description

This beautiful and much-loved apartment is available and ready for a new chapter. Occupied for many years by its resident owners, it has seen them through many phases of their lives until their growing family regretfully needed more space than it was able to offer. Located on the third floor of a prestigious and sought-after building, the 108 sqm apartment offers many features that are rare and desirable these days. The wooden floors and high ceilings give a nod to the classic and a time when construction was solid and built to last. The spacious, open plan layout however, feels very modern and allows a connecting flow throughout the space. Well laid out and light, the living area is warm and welcoming in the best way. The kitchen is renovated and offers a practical, neat working area. It looks out onto the livingroom and dining area. The livingroom opens up onto a balcony with sliding doors, allowing you to let the outdoors in and admire the blue sky and even bluer ocean beyond. The balcony, which also has an enviable view of Lion's Head, is also accessible from the dining area through a single door. The main bedroom, currently used a childrens room and play area, also looks out at the same view through a large picture window. The second bedroom is also light and surprisingly spacious. Both bedrooms have built in cupboards which provide ample storage. The apartment also has 2 bathrooms, one of which is full family bathroom. In addition, the apartment has one lock up garage and an allocated parking bay. The building is well-maintained, has 24 hour security, lift and stair access and a beautiful garden. Walking distance to the world-renowned Atlantic Seaboard promenade, surrounded by countless restaurants and amenities, a stones throw away from the award-winning Clifton and Camps Beaches and at the foot of the famous Lion's Head mountain peak, this location is incomparable.
